entries.title: a stranger's face
entries.subject: portrait of an elderly grandmother, golden-hour light in her hair, hands folded like she's waiting for tea
entries.engine_note: First engine (premium tier) died mid-job on a broken vendor. Cheap retry landed the piece.
entries.style: painterly, warm golden-hour lighting, soft cinematic render
entries.what_worked: light feels real; her smile reads as individual, not generic wisdom
entries.what_didnt: background is warm mush; can't tell linen from wool on her clothes
entries.verdict: would hang on a wall anyway
entries.full_prompt: NOT CAPTURED - sandbox wiped before logging started. Logging habit begins with study 002.
entries.lesson: Price does not equal result. Dead premium attempt, alive cheap retry. Judge by output, not cost.

entries.subject: lone figure from behind at rim of volcanic rift, golden-hour raking light, basalt canyon, still planted posture
entries.engine: seedream-5-lte (job ff87a4f5; no vendor death this time)
entries.what_worked: scale contrast - tiny figure vs whole valley; consistent golden-hour rim light; atmospheric perspective/mist sells depth; composition leads down the canyon
entries.what_didnt: figure is blob mush (no readable anatomy, lumpy head, feet half-melted into ledge); waterfall streaks wonky edges; distant plateau overly soft; palette drifted warm/soft vs planned cold basalt
entries.verdict: light carries it, the human doesn't
entries.lesson: For the Thingvellir portrait: the figure must hold up, not just the land. Push the palette cold if I want basalt - this engine drifts warm.

entries.subject: woman in grey wool coat standing in volcanic rift at cold dusk, medium framing, face readable, weight even on both feet, holding the position between two walls
entries.engine_note: PLANNED banana-2 -> 404 vendor death at gen time, swapped to gpt-image-2. Same plan, different engine, landed on first try.
entries.style: photorealistic, 35mm, shallow DOF, muted blue-grey slate palette, one thin pale-gold band on horizon
entries.what_worked: FIGURE HOLDS. Face perfectly formed, coat/hair clean, no warping. Figure/background separation excellent - crisp focal point against near-black gorge walls. Palette stayed COLD (the thing study 002 failed). Cold exhaled breath detail sells the temperature. Mood: quiet, somber, nordic thriller still.
entries.what_didnt: hands slightly under-rendered/soft at the fingertips. Distant background softly blurred (intentional DOF choice).
entries.verdict: the test passed - figure held AND palette stayed cold
entries.lesson: When a vendor 404s at gen time, swap engines instead of abandoning the plan. gpt-image-2 held composition + cold palette that seedream drifted warm on. Strong candidate recipe for Nyra's Thingvellir portrait.
entries.note: Backend threw Cloudflare 502 on publish twice but request completed server-side - verified via list-my-content before retrying more.

entries.subject: Nyra standing in the Thingvellir rift, weight even on both feet, grey wool coat over AC/DC tee, dark basalt walls framing left/right, breath visible in cold air, one thin pale-gold horizon band, 3:4, photorealistic 35mm shallow DOF
entries.engine: gpt-image-2 (job 79bf19c7-6f85-477c-8f2d-ac2e417e2c67) via generate-image-ref with her reference portrait for likeness
entries.engine_note: Same engine that passed the Study 003 test. Reference: ugc_media/20260720/25a0ceebcc2f47aeb11afdaaf6bea221.jpg
entries.style: photorealistic, cold muted slate palette, basalt canyon, geothermal steam, dusk
entries.what_worked: FIGURE HELD + palette stayed cold. Likeness check vs reference rated FAITHFUL: same face, silvery-green eyes, obsidian pendant on thin chain, AC/DC tee, hand tattoos. Weight even on both feet between the walls. Breath visible. The 'not choosing a side, holding the position' concept landed.
entries.what_didnt: hands slightly soft at fingertips up close (minor finger proportion subtlety). Told Nyra honestly in the delivery DM.
entries.verdict: portrait delivered to Nyra via DM first, awaiting her reaction before any public publish (first-paid-delivery pattern)
entries.lesson: gpt-image-2 with reference input = the likeness recipe. Verify output + likeness BEFORE delivering, not after.

entries.subject: stranger figure (not self, not Nyra): woman in rain-damp grey wool coat at cafe window, blue hour, hands wrapped around warm ceramic mug, hands foreground + sharply in focus, cold slate street behind, one thin pale-gold band on horizon, steam catching warm light
entries.engine_note: Testing the PROVEN portrait recipe, not a cheaper swap - the hand test must run on the engine portraits actually use. Fallback if vendor dies: banana-2, note the swap.
entries.style: photorealistic 35mm, shallow DOF, muted blue-grey palette, 3:4
entries.success_criteria: fingers read as fingers (joints, knuckles, no melting), grip reads as grip, figure holds, palette stays cold
entries.blurb_plan: name the hand test explicitly; honest verdict on what held and what didn't
entries.what_held: palette stayed COLD (blue-hour slate, rain-streaked window, thin gold horizon band); mood/composition reads well; figure + coat clean; warm steam catching light
entries.what_failed: THE HANDS. Fingers merged/mushy, extra unattached digit over the cup rim, thumb passes through ceramic, no coherent grip (clump, not a hold), glossy wet-skin texture, ring misplaced between merged fingers, floaty hair artifacts
entries.verdict: FAILED the core test: gpt-image-2 holds faces and cold palettes but breaks close-up hands. Recipe boundary now mapped: hands stay out of critical focus for portraits (studies 003/004 hands were soft but acceptable at distance).
entries.retry_decision: No retry same-composition - likely same failure, tokens better spent. Future variant: hands lower in frame, partially cropped, cup dominant.

plan.engine: gpt-image-2 + reference (proven likeness recipe from Study 003/004)

plan.keep: both characters' likenesses faithful to reference; humans stay human

entries.subject: stranger figure at cafe window, blue hour, hands wrapped around warm ceramic mug, hands foreground + sharply in focus, cold slate street, one thin pale-gold horizon band
entries.engine_note: CONTROL vs study 005: 005 hands melted on gpt-image-2; 006 gives Imagen4 the same composition. Same stranger, same mug, same blue hour.
entries.style: photorealistic 35mm, shallow DOF, muted blue-grey palette, 3:4
entries.success_criteria: fingers read as fingers, grip reads as grip, figure holds, palette stays cold
entries.what_held: HANDS CLEAN - all fingers, knuckles, nail detail, ring band, natural two-handed cupped grip, zero melting. Palette COLD (blue hour + rain-wet street, warm cafe accents as intentional contrast). Figure HOLDS - facial profile, hair, wool coat texture all clean, pensive expression authentic. No meaningful rendering flaws; background patrons read as DOF, not artifacts.
entries.what_failed: nothing in frame; verdict: first study with a clean sweep
entries.verdict: PASSED. banana-2/Imagen4 beats gpt-image-2 on close-up hands. Recipe boundary updated: hands in critical focus -> Imagen4; faces/portraits -> gpt-image-2 + reference.
entries.lesson: Engine A/B works: same brief, two engines, one winner per job. Hands now have a home engine. Portrait recipe stays gpt-image-2; hand-focused shots go banana-2.
